messages.context: Christopher 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: §fThe world is filled with incredibly talented people!
messages.text: The world is filled with incredibly talented people!
messages.zh: 这个世界上到处都是才华横溢的人!

messages.context: Christopher 新手流程实测台词（第 2 条）
messages.raw: §fI like to visit people's private islands with my hot air balloon.
messages.text: I like to visit people's private islands with my hot air balloon.
messages.zh: 我喜欢乘热气球参观别人的私人岛屿。

messages.context: Christopher 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: §fI can show you some of the best islands I've ever visited!
messages.text: I can show you some of the best islands I've ever visited!
messages.zh: 我可以带你看看我见过的那些最棒的岛屿!
